newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian metals see mixed results, world market down.
newsitem.headline: Indian metals see mixed results, world market down.

text.p: Indian tin and nickel prices on Friday fell while other base metals were steady in limited trade, dealers said.
Tin prices fell by 300 rupees at 28,700 rupees per quintal on sluggish physical buying while world market losses prompted selling by local importers.
Nickel lost 200 rupees at 33,600 rupees per quintal on higher supplies.

Copper was steady at the reduced level of 13,500 rupees per quintal after losing 150 rupees on Tuesday. Aluminium was steady at 7,700 rupees, zinc at 8,250 rupees and lead at 4,150 rupees per quintal amid nominal trading. Zinc was up by 100 rupees and lead was up by 50 rupees per quintal on Thursday.
